lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，袍子没有声音。
lines.en: I come out of the mist and my robe makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我浮着走，脚下什么都没有。
lines.en: I travel hovering, with nothing underfoot.

lines.zh: 我的镰刀拖在后面，划出一道灰。
lines.en: My scythe drags behind and draws a grey line.

lines.zh: 我朝那片安静的坟地挪。
lines.en: I drift toward that quiet graveyard.
When I move, the mist comes with me.

lines.zh: 我的袍角垂着，几乎不摆。
lines.en: My hem hangs and barely swings.
I slide slowly across the steps.

lines.zh: 我朝着有气息的地方去。
lines.en: I go toward the living breath.

lines.zh: 我从一棵枯树旁边过去。
lines.en: I pass beside a dead tree.
My shadow is darker than the mist.
I hang here with the scythe lowered.

lines.zh: 我把手伸进雾里，又收回。
lines.en: I reach into the mist and draw back.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，袍子也不动。
lines.en: I do not move, and neither does my robe.
I am counting the living here.
There is a small light in my sockets.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，看向另一侧。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly aside.
Cold mist gathers on the scythe.
I wait for the mist to thicken.
I make no motion at all.
I wait for a name to be spoken.
There is no body inside my robe.

lines.zh: 我把镰刀换到另只手上。
lines.en: I shift the scythe to my other hand.
I regard my own finger bones.
Fresh frost forms on the scythe.
I push the mist a little forward.
I listen for someone to call me.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向你，光在眼窝里。
lines.en: I turn my face to you, light in my sockets.
You still have a long thread.

lines.zh: 我打量你，先从你的眼睛。
lines.en: I look you over, starting with your eyes.
I am not in a hurry; time is not mine.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就近一步。
lines.en: You step back and I come a step.
I raise the scythe upright.

lines.zh: 你的名字我还不打算念。
lines.en: I do not mean to speak your name yet.
The warmth on you is very conspicuous.
I float before you, motionless.
Leave, if you will.

lines.zh: 我低头，雾从袍子里散出。
lines.en: I bow my head and mist spills from my robe.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔着一层雾。
lines.en: Only a layer of mist lies between us.

lines.zh: 我的袍子被撕开一道，雾散了些。
lines.en: My robe tears and some mist escapes.
I slip half a foot back.
The light in my sockets dims.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我身上，没有声音。
lines.en: That blow lands without a sound.
I slowly gather my robe closed.
I raise the scythe to guard.
The mist gathers again.
I have graven that in.
I have not yet scattered.
I twist round toward you.
I do not take such things.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我不看。
lines.en: You hold it up and I do not look.
What I collect is something else.
Set that little thing down.

lines.zh: 我朝它伸了伸手，又收回。
lines.en: I reach toward it and withdraw.
I am not here to eat.
You need not give me anything.
I drift wide of your hand.
It slowly loses heat in the mist.
I go on waiting.

lines.zh: 你撞进雾里，什么也没碰到。
lines.en: You hit the mist and touch nothing.

lines.zh: 我的袍角擦过你，留下寒气。
lines.en: My hem brushes you and leaves a chill behind.

lines.zh: 我的袍子拂了你一下，很冷。
lines.en: My robe brushes you, very cold.
A shudder runs through you.
I draw back half a foot.
I put a hand out to hold you off.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，雾散了一下又合上。
lines.en: You strike me; the mist parts and closes again.
I cannot be pushed.
I turn my back to you.
Do not crowd me like that.

lines.zh: 我已经很久不是活人了。
lines.en: I have not been a living thing for a long time.
I no longer need such things.

lines.zh: 我朝它看了一眼，就转开。
lines.en: I glance at it and turn away.
My scythe hangs and does not move.
The mist separates us.
I have no hand to hold.
I leave it where it was.
I go on along the road.
This road fits only one.
I make not a single sound.
I reach and it rises.
I gather it into my sleeve.
This thing has no weight.
I look, and put it back.
I cannot hold anything living.
It grows cold in my palm.
I do not use this thing.
I open my hand and let it fall back.
I keep it in the mist.
I gather it into my sleeve.
I see the breath you exhale.
I lift the scythe.
I have entered you in the ledger.
I drift toward you.
The mist thickens here.
I begin to speak your name.
You back to the wall and there is no way.
I put up a palm.
When I lock on, the wind stops.
The warmth on you is receding.
One thread will soon break.
I stand before you.
I step onward.
I level the scythe.
You have only a few steps left.
I am perfectly unhurried.
I have your outline.
I have marked this moment.
I raise my hand slowly.
I lean down toward you.
I follow you and the mist follows me.
You change direction and I change angle.
I press behind you, silent.
You look back and I have already shifted.
I wait for you to halt.
My scythe stays pointed at you.

lines.zh: 雾把我们的声音都吃了。
lines.en: The mist swallows both our sounds.
The more you run, the thicker the mist.
I do not need eyes to see you.
You are already on my road.
I lower the scythe slowly.
This circle is already shut.
I am counting your steps.
One more step and I act.

lines.zh: 你身后的雾已经合上了。
lines.en: The mist behind you has closed.
I need no breath and no waiting.
Only a few feet remain between us.
You have heard the sound in the mist.
I reach my hand out.
The hour has come.
I sweep the scythe across.
I press the scythe's back on its shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，它的气就散了。
lines.en: I reach out and its warmth scatters.

lines.zh: 这一下切开了它的护甲。
lines.en: That cut opens its armor.

lines.zh: 它砍我，袍子只破了道口。
lines.en: It cuts me and only tears my robe.
I sweep again.
I shunt it away.
The blade passes with a soft sound.
It retreats and I stop in the mist.
My scythe lowers.
That will be enough.
I turn my body about slowly.
The mist gathers around me again.
I draw my hand back into the sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从雾里凝出来，先是镰刀。
lines.en: I gather out of the mist, scythe first.
The moment I appear, everything cools.

lines.zh: 我把脸抬起来，光在眼窝里。
lines.en: I raise my face, light in my sockets.
There are many threads here.
I make one slow round.
My robe reaches the ground.
The mist rises with me.
I stand the scythe at my side.
I head for the nearest warmth.
My feet make no sound.
The wind here is cold.
I begin counting.

lines.zh: 我把手伸进雾里探了探。
lines.en: I reach into the mist and feel.
The shadow reaches earth first.
I let my head sink low.
I step forward.
The moment I come, the insects fall silent.
I wait for a thread to loosen.

lines.zh: 我把镰刀在手里转了一圈。
lines.en: I turn the scythe once in my hand.
I lower my eyes to the ground.

lines.zh: 火把雾烧开了，我退到后面。
lines.en: Fire burns the mist away and I retreat.

lines.zh: 我坠落时袍子翻起来，什么也撑不住。
lines.en: As I fall my robe billows and nothing holds me.

lines.zh: 水没进袍里，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water soaks into my robe and I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 炸风把我的袍子掀得散开。
lines.en: The blast throws my robe open.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，我身上多了个洞。
lines.en: Something passes through and leaves a hole in me.

lines.zh: 术式缠住我，雾都不动了。
lines.en: An art binds me and even the mist stops.
Too long without a single thread.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了我，也烧散了一部分。
lines.en: Lightning lights me up and burns part of me away.
I fall and my robe goes first.
